effect.en: Periculum was the incantation of a charm that allowed the caster to shoot red sparks from their wand.
effect.fr: Charme qui fait jaillir de la baguette des étincelles rouges.

hand.fr: Pointer la baguette vers le ciel

effect.en: The Permanent Sticking Charm was a charm that magically stuck one object to another indefinitely. It was unknown how, if at all, this charm could be lifted, leaving an object to stick indefinitely.
effect.fr: Sort qui colle magiquement une chose à une autre. Il est extrêmement difficile de détacher quelque chose collé à la Glu perpétuelle.

effect.en: Peskipiksi Pesternomi was supposedly the incantation of a charm meant to capture (or possibly repel) pixies.
effect.fr: Incantation censée capturer les pixies — ou du moins les repousser.

effect.en: The Pimple Jinx, also known as the Furnunculus Curse (Furnunculus), was a Dark charm that caused a person to break out in boils/pimples when it came in contact with their skin. It could induce acne. The effects could be cleared by the Boil-Cure Potion.
effect.fr: De "furunculus" L. "petit voleur", qui a donné le mot furoncle.

effect.en: The Pinhead Jinx was a jinx. Its exact effect was unknown.
effect.fr: Jinx dont l’effet exact demeure inconnu.

effect.en: Piscifors was the incantation of a transforming spell that could be used to transform the target into a fish. Professor Horace Slughorn described it as being beautiful.
effect.fr: Métamorphose qui change la cible en poisson. Horace Slughorn la trouvait fort belle.

effect.en: The Placement Charm was a charm that magically placed an object somewhere without the wizard or witch having to do it physically. Placement Charms could be used to place a bridle on a kelpie to render it harmless and docile.
effect.fr: Sort pour mettre quelque chose en place.

effect.en: The Porcupine Jinx was a jinx. Its exact effect was unknown.
effect.fr: Jinx dont l’effet exact demeure inconnu.

effect.en: The Portkey Spell (Portus) was a charm used to turn an ordinary object into a Portkey. Since creating Portkeys were restricted by the Ministry of Magic, the usage of this spell was, by extension, restricted as well. This was the subject of a question of the Theory of Charms O.W.L. in 1996
effect.fr: Transforme l'objet visé en Portoloin.

effect.en: Prior Incantato, otherwise known as the Prior-Use Spell, was a charm that forced a wand to show an "echo" of the last spell it had performed. Its counter-charm was the Eradication Spell, which removed these images. Priori Incantatem, otherwise known as the "reverse spell effect", was an especially rare manifestation of this spell that occurred when two wands with the same core (that is, taken from the same exact specimen of animal) attempted to duel each other. The winner's wand forced the loser's wand to produce "echoes" of the most recent spells performed in reverse order.
effect.fr: Peut être lancé comme formule (" Prior Incanto "). L'effet produit oblige la baguette à émettre une image fantomatique du dernier sort émis. Les images peuvent être détruites par la formule Deletrius.

hand.en: Hold tip of wand to targeted wand
hand.fr: Tenir la pointe de la baguette contre celle de la cible

effect.en: The Proficiency Charm , was a charm which could be used on an individual to boost their performance with certain individual talents.
effect.fr: Charme qui, jeté sur quelqu’un, avive certains talents particuliers.

effect.en: The Projectile Jinx (Waddiwasi) was a jinx that could be used to propel a small wad of material at high velocity.
effect.fr: Projette une boule de chewing-gum du trou d'une serrure.

effect.en: The Protean Charm (incantation unknown) was a charm that allowed several objects to change simultaneously through a common purpose. It was considered advanced N.E.W.T.-level magic and all members of Dumbledore's Army were impressed when Hermione Granger revealed that she could cast this spell.
effect.fr: Sortilège complexe qui fait changer quelque chose de forme.

effect.en: The Protection Charm was a charm which provided enhanced individual's defence, making them more protected from harm.
effect.fr: Charme qui fortifie les défenses de quelqu’un et le met mieux à l’abri du mal.

effect.en: Encircling the caster with a protective ring of black fire that incinerated enemies and left allies unharmed
effect.fr: Entoure le lanceur d’un anneau de flammes noires qui incinèrent les ennemis et épargnent les alliés.

effect.en: Protego horribilis was the incantation of a powerful protective charm.
effect.fr: Puissant charme de protection.

hand.fr: Pointer la baguette vers le ciel

effect.en: Protego Maxima was a stronger version of the Shield Charm that, when cast in combination with Fianto Duri and Repello Inimicum, conjured up an almost impregnable magical protection barrier.
effect.fr: Version renforcée du charme du Bouclier. Combiné à Fianto Duri et Repello Inimicum, il dresse une barrière magique presque imprenable.

hand.fr: Pointer la baguette vers le ciel

effect.en: Protego totalum was the incantation of a protective enchantment used to shield a certain area or dwelling for an extended period of time. It was a variation of the Shield Charm, and was used to stop and repel any intruder and/or spell from the protected area, except the most powerful curses, including the Unforgivable Curses.
effect.fr: Enchantement protecteur, variante du charme du Bouclier, qui met à l’abri pour longtemps un lieu ou une demeure. Il arrête et repousse intrus et sorts — sauf les malédictions les plus fortes, dont les Sortilèges Impardonnables.

effect.en: Pullus was the incantation of a transforming jinx used to transfigure the target into a chicken; in particular, Erklings were rather vulnerable to this spell.
effect.fr: Jinx de métamorphose qui change la cible en poulet. Les Erklings y sont particulièrement sensibles.

name.fr: Jinx de la tête de citrouille

effect.en: The Pumpkin-Head Jinx (Melofors), also known as the Melofors Jinx, was a jinx that encased the victim's head in a pumpkin. To outsiders, it appeared that the victim's head was transformed into a pumpkin.
effect.fr: Jinx (Melofors) qui enferme la tête de la victime dans une citrouille. Vu du dehors, on croirait que la tête elle-même s’est changée en citrouille.

effect.en: Purple Firecrackers was a charm used to emit purple firecrackers from the tip of one's wand.
effect.fr: Charme qui fait jaillir de la baguette des pétards violets.

effect.en: The Pus Squirting Hex was a hex that caused pus to squirt from the victim's nose.
effect.fr: Maléfice qui fait gicler du pus du nez de la victime.

effect.en: The Quietening Charm (Quietus) was a charm used to quieten sounds. It was the counter-charm to the Amplifying Charm.
effect.fr: Inverse l'effet du sortilège Sonorus , rendant à l'auteur du sortilège sa voix normale.

effect.en: Red Sparks (Vermillious) was a charm that precipitated a jet of red sparks from the tip of the wand, something that might be useful to signal an emergency and call for help. It could also be used offensively as a minor duelling spell, but it was not effective against armoured or metallic opponents. It was covered in the book The Dark Forces: A Guide to Self-Protection by Quentin Trimble. Vermillious Duo and Vermillious Tria were more powerful versions of Red Sparks.
effect.fr: Charme (Vermillious) qui fait jaillir un jet d’étincelles rouges, utile pour signaler un danger. On peut aussi s’en servir en duel, encore qu’il serve peu contre un adversaire en armure. Vermillious Duo et Vermillious Tria en sont des versions plus fortes.

effect.en: The Reductor Curse (Reducto) was a curse that blasted solid objects to pieces. It was rather easy to reduce a target to a fine mist or a pile of ashes.
effect.fr: Voir REDUCTO

effect.en: The Refilling Charm was a charm that was used to refill whatever the caster pointed at with the drink originally in the container. This charm could be used verbally or non-verbally.
effect.fr: Charme qui remplit à nouveau le récipient visé de la boisson qu’il contenait. On peut le jeter à voix haute ou sans parole.

hand.fr: Pointer la baguette vers la cible

effect.en: Reparifarge was the incantation of an untransfiguration spell. It appeared to be a general spell used to counter the effects of a Transformation spell that was poorly performed and only partially Transfigured the object in question. This spell was covered in A Beginner's Guide to Transfiguration, which stressed the importance of at least attempting this spell when necessary, as the products of incomplete Transfigurations could be dangerous.
effect.fr: Contre-métamorphose générale, destinée à corriger une transformation maladroite ou inachevée. Le Guide de la métamorphose à l’usage des débutants insiste pour qu’on l’essaie toujours : le produit d’une métamorphose incomplète peut être dangereux.

effect.en: Reparifors was the incantation of a healing charm that reverted minor magically-induced ailments, such as paralysis and poisoning.
effect.fr: Charme de guérison qui dissipe les maux magiques légers, tels la paralysie ou un empoisonnement.

effect.en: Repels enemies; if used with Protego Maxima and Fianto Duri, it disintegrates anything that comes in contact with the barrier
effect.fr: Repousse les ennemis. Combiné à Protego Maxima et Fianto Duri, il désintègre tout ce qui touche la barrière.

hand.fr: Pointer la baguette vers le ciel

effect.en: The Revealing Charm (Aparecium) was a charm that revealed secret messages written in Invisible Ink, or any other hidden markings written using other means such as Concealing charms.
effect.fr: Charme (Aparecium) qui révèle les messages écrits à l’encre invisible, ainsi que d’autres marques cachées — y compris par un charme de dissimulation.

effect.en: The Revelio Charm (Revelio) was a charm used to reveal concealed objects, messages, invisible things, and passages or any other secretly written messages and hidden markings. It was considered difficult for a second-year student at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. It may have also been used to reveal the true appearance of someone who changed their appearance with a spell. It had no effect on a transformed Animagus; a different spell had to be used to force them back into human form. It was also useful for revealing disguised Chameleon Ghouls.
effect.fr: Charme (Revelio) qui révèle objets cachés, messages, êtres invisibles, passages secrets et autres marques dérobées. Difficile pour un élève de deuxième année. Il peut aussi dévoiler le vrai visage de quelqu’un qui a changé d’apparence — mais il n’agit pas sur un Animagus transformé, ni de la même façon sur les goules caméléons, qu’il aide toutefois à démasquer.

effect.en: A spell whose exact effect remains unknown.
effect.fr: Sort dont l’effet exact demeure inconnu.

effect.en: Reverte was the incantation of a charm that could return or revert objects to their original positions or states, which might cause the targeted objects to move in reverse.
effect.fr: Charme qui ramène des objets à leur place ou à leur état d’origine, parfois en les faisant reculer.

effect.en: The Reviving Spell (Rennervate) was a spell whose effect depended on the intent of the caster, and were either categorised as a charm that could be used to awaken a living target from a state of unconsciousness, and consequently served as the counter-charm to the Stunning Spell, or as a curse that would reanimate a dead target, typically by Dark wizards, turning the corpse in question into a grisly puppet known as an Inferius.
effect.fr: Sort pour rendre à la vie une personne stupéfixiée.

hand.fr: Pointer la baguette vers la poitrine

effect.en: The Revulsion Jinx (Relashio) was a jinx that forced the target to release its grip on whatever it was holding. It worked on both living and inanimate targets, so long as it was holding something.
effect.fr: Envoie un jet d'étincelles brûlantes. Sous l'eau, cette formule produit un jet d'eau bouillante.

effect.en: Rose Growth was a charm that made rosebushes grow at an unusually fast pace.
effect.fr: Charme qui fait croître les rosiers à une vitesse inhabituelle.

effect.en: This spell was a charm, that was used to propel boats on bodies of water, making them row faster.
effect.fr: Charme qui propulse les barques sur l’eau et les fait avancer plus vite.

hand.en: Tap twice on boat with wand
hand.fr: Tapoter deux fois le bateau de la baguette

effect.en: Salvio hexia was the incantation of a protective enchantment which deflected hexes from the area. The spell was a powerful protective charm, with even low-skilled casters being able to produce an enchantment which protected a small area against most hexes. The more powerful the caster, the more powerful spells it would be able to block and the larger the area protected by the spell. Extremely powerful casters could cast the spell over entire castles.
effect.fr: Enchantement protecteur qui détourne les maléfices d’une zone. Même un lanceur peu habile peut en couvrir un petit espace contre la plupart des hex ; plus il est fort, plus le sort arrête de sorts puissants, et plus large est l’aire protégée. Les plus grands peuvent en couvrir des châteaux entiers.

hand.en: Downwards, palm of opposite hand held outward
hand.fr: Mouvement descendant, paume de l’autre main tournée vers l’extérieur

effect.en: The Sardine Hex was a hex that caused the victim to begin sneezing up sardines.
effect.fr: Maléfice qui fait éternuer des sardines à la victime.

effect.en: This unidentified spell conjured a creamy sauce from the tip of the wand. Molly Weasley used this spell in August of 1994 to pour some sauce in a pot to make dinner for her family, Harry Potter and Hermione Granger.
effect.fr: This unidentified spell conjured a creamy sauce from the tip of the wand. Molly Weasley used this spell in August of 1994 to pour some sauce in a pot to make dinner for her family, Harry Potter and Hermione Granger.

hand.fr: Onduler la baguette autour de soi

effect.en: The Scouring Charm (Scourgify) was a cleaning charm used for washing things. It could also be used to clean out smaller bundimun infestations. This spell was listed in the third chapter of Book of Spells by Miranda Goshawk. Many wizarding families used this spell, both for cleaning and punishing people who swore, as the spell caused human mouths to be filled with soap. This spell was also one of the few methods of effectively cleaning the teeth of a Leucrotta, as they disliked having their teeth touched with a brush.
effect.fr: Nettoye les choses, les ongles par exemple.

effect.en: The Sealant Charm was a charm that magically sealed envelopes. All applicants for wand permits in the United States were required by the Magical Congress of the United States of America to close the envelope in which they sent their applications back to the Wand Permit Office with this spell.
effect.fr: Charme qui scelle magiquement les enveloppes. Aux États-Unis, le Congrès magique exigeait que les demandes de permis de baguette lui parviennent ainsi fermées.

effect.en: The Sea Urchin Jinx was a jinx that transfigured the target victim into something similar to a sea urchin, with tiny spikes erupting all over the victim's body. It apparently created awful discomfort in the target.
effect.fr: Jinx qui donne à la victime l’allure d’un oursin : de minuscules piquants lui percent la peau. L’inconfort est atroce.

name.fr: Charme de saisie et de traction

effect.en: The seize and pull charm, also known as the Carpe Retractum Spell (Carpe Retractum), was a charm that produced a magical, retractable cord of light, that could be used to pull objects towards the caster, or, if the target was fixed in place, to pull the caster towards the target.
effect.fr: Charme (Carpe Retractum) qui fait naître un cordon de lumière rétractable : il attire l’objet vers le lanceur ou, si la cible est fixe, le lanceur vers la cible.

effect.en: The Severing Charm (Diffindo) was a charm used to precisely and accurately cut something. If used inappropriately, it could cause death or injury. It was taught in first-year, fourth-year and fifth-year Charms classes at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. It was also covered in first-year and second-year Herbology classes at Hogwarts. A spellbook for this charm could be found in one of the Herbology greenhouses; the charm was also detailed in both Book of Spells and The Standard Book of Spells, Grade 1.
effect.fr: Sortilège pour briser ou déchirer un objet.

effect.en: The Shield Charm (Protego) was a charm that protected the caster with an invisible shield that reflected spells and blocked physical entities. It was a part of the Defence Against the Dark Arts curriculum and was taught to sixth years at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. There were also multiple variations of the Shield Charm.
effect.fr: Ce sort crée une barrière magique qui dévie les maléfices envoyés à son auteur.

light.en: Invisible on its own, reflected light of spell
light.fr: Invisible on its own, reflected light of spell

effect.en: This spell , which produced a powerful bluish-white bolt, could be used to break large magical protections such as Protego horribilis.
effect.fr: Sort qui projette un puissant éclair bleu-blanc, assez pour briser de vastes protections telles que Protego Horribilis.

hand.en: Point wand to the place where the spell is desired to hit
hand.fr: Pointer la baguette vers l’endroit visé

effect.en: This unnamed spell was used by Harry Potter and Ronald Weasley in 1997 during their Horcrux hunt in an attempt to catch a rabbit for food. The pair also engaged in a duel against each other using the spell, chasing each other about the meadow and trying to shoot each other.
effect.fr: Sort sans nom dont Harry Potter et Ron Weasley se servirent en 1997, durant la chasse aux Horcruxes, pour tenter d’abattre un lapin. Ils s’en défièrent aussi l’un l’autre, se poursuivant dans le pré.

hand.fr: Pointer la baguette vers la cible

effect.en: The Shrinking Charm (Reducio) was a charm that caused an object to shrink. It was the counter-charm to the Engorgement Charm, causing enlarged objects to return to their original size. The Shrinking Charm was also used as the potion-making spell for the Shrinking Solution. The use of a Shrinking Charm on a human was considered both complicated and dangerous.
effect.fr: inverse de : Amplificatum

effect.en: The Silencing Charm (Silencio) was a charm that rendered the victim temporarily mute. Working on both beasts and beings, it was immensely difficult to perform, more so on ravens than frogs. If performed incorrectly, the target would swell up to an immense size and begin making deafening sounds.
effect.fr: Un sortilège pour rendre quelque chose silencieux.

effect.en: The Singing Charm (Cantis) was a charm used to make the target break out in song.
effect.fr: Charme (Cantis) qui fait éclater la cible en chanson.

effect.en: The Skurge Charm (Skurge) was a charm that could be used to clean up the sticky green ectoplasm created by passing ghosts. It could also be used to frighten spirits, such as the aforementioned ghosts, as well as poltergeists. It was not be confused with the more versatile Scouring Charm.
effect.fr: Charme (Skurge) qui nettoie l’ectoplasme vert et gluant laissé par les fantômes. Il peut aussi effrayer esprits et poltergeists. À ne pas confondre avec le charme de récurage, plus versatile.

effect.en: The Sliding Spell (Glisseo) was a Transfiguration spell that could be used to transform a staircase into a smooth slide. It was very old, having been in use since the Middle Ages. This spell could have been used to enchant a staircase to become a slide if certain people tried to climb it, so it was useful for preventing people from reaching a certain place. It was also useful in a combat scenario, as sliding down a slide was a much faster means of escaping pursuing enemies than running down a set of stairs.
effect.fr: Métamorphose (Glisseo) qui change un escalier en toboggan lisse. Très ancien — on s’en servait déjà au Moyen Âge —, il peut ensorceler une marche pour qu’elle se dérobe à certains visiteurs. En combat, glisser est aussi plus rapide que de dévaler les marches.

effect.en: The Slippery Jinx was a jinx that made an object slippery and difficult to hold.
effect.fr: Jinx qui rend un objet glissant, presque impossible à tenir.

effect.en: The Slowing Charm, also known as the Braking Charm, (Arresto Momentum) was a charm that could be used to slow the velocity of an object. It was taught in second-year and fifth-year Charms class at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. This charm was also placed on broomsticks to help them stop faster. The Firebolt had an "unbreakable Braking Charm" placed on it.
effect.fr: Charme de freinage (Arresto Momentum) qui ralentit un objet. On l’enseigne en Sortilèges en deuxième et cinquième années à Poudlard. On l’applique aussi aux balais ; l’Éclair de Feu porte un « charme de freinage incassable ».

effect.en: The Slug-vomiting Charm (Slugulus Eructo) was a curse, that forced the victim to vomit slugs. They may also have taken on a sallow complexion as a side-effect. It was described as a green jet of light. Treacle fudge can cure the effects in a few seconds, although it will eventually wear off on its own.
effect.fr: Malédiction (Slugulus Eructo) qui force la victime à vomir des limaces ; le teint peut aussi jaunir. Un jet de lumière verte. Un caramel à la mélasse en dissipe les effets en quelques secondes ; sinon, cela passe tout seul.

effect.en: This spell released a burst of blue light, which caused a huge explosion that ravaged and devastated everything in its range. Additionally, it could be used to smash windows.
effect.fr: Sort qui libère un éclat de lumière bleue et une énorme explosion qui ravage tout dans son rayon. Il peut aussi briser des vitres.

effect.en: The Smokescreen Spell (Fumos) was a charm used to create a defensive cloud of smoke from the wand that hindered visibility. This spell was quite useful in duelling, as the smoke hid the caster, preventing an opponent from accurately aiming their spells, as well as allowing the caster to escape unseen. This spell was covered in the book The Dark Forces: A Guide to Self-Protection by Professor Quentin Trimble.
effect.fr: Charme (Fumos) qui fait naître un nuage de fumée défensif, assez pour brouiller la vue. En duel, il masque le lanceur, gêne la visée adverse et permet de s’éclipser. On le trouve dans Les Forces du Mal : un guide de protection personnelle, du professeur Quentin Trimble.

effect.en: The Snake Summons Spell (Serpensortia) was a transfiguration spell that conjured a live snake from the end of the wand. Out of all of the spells used to conjure living things, The Snake Summons Spell was amongst the easiest, alongside the Bird-Conjuring Charm. The counter-spell to this conjuration was the Snake-Vanishing Spell.
effect.fr: Fait jaillir un énorme serpent du bout de la baguette.

effect.en: The Snake-Vanishing Spell (Vipera Evanesca) was a transfiguration spell that vanished snakes. As such, it could be used as a counter-spell for the Snake Summons Spell, the fire to snake spell, or likely any other spell that produced snakes.
effect.fr: Métamorphose (Vipera Evanesca) qui fait disparaître les serpents. Elle sert de contre-sort au sortilège de conjuration de serpent, au sort feu-en-serpent, et sans doute à tout sort qui produit des serpents.

effect.en: The Softening Charm (Spongify) was a charm that softened objects, making them rubbery and bouncy.
effect.fr: Charme (Spongify) qui ramollit les objets, les rendant caoutchouteux et rebondissants.

effect.en: Sonicus was the incantation for a spell. Its exact effect was unknown, but it didn't amplify sound.
effect.fr: Sort dont l’effet exact demeure inconnu ; il n’amplifie toutefois pas le son.

effect.en: The Sonorous Charm was a charm that emitted a magnified roar from the tip of the wand. This noise disrupted all in its path, and could even be used to harm opponents.
effect.fr: Charme qui fait jaillir de la baguette un rugissement amplifié. Ce bruit bouscule tout sur son passage et peut blesser un adversaire.

effect.en: The Specialised Revealing Charm (Specialis Revelio) was a charm that revealed any spells performed on objects or potions. It was a variation of the Revelio Charm.
effect.fr: Utilisé pour identifier les ingrédients d'une potion.

effect.en: The Spider-Banishing Charm (Arania Exumai) was a charm used to blast away Acromantulas or other large spiders. If the spell missed and struck a stone, it would produce a large black scorch mark, and thus was not recommended for use on humans, although casting through or along a human produced no ill effect as long as a spider was struck.
effect.fr: Charme (Arania Exumai) qui projette au loin Acromentules et autres grandes araignées. S’il manque sa cible et frappe la pierre, il y laisse une large brûlure noire : on déconseille de le jeter sur un humain, encore qu’un rayon passant près de quelqu’un n’ait pas d’effet fâcheux, pourvu qu’une araignée soit atteinte.

effect.en: The Sponge-Knees Curse was a curse which made the target's legs spongy, making it difficult for them to walk or stand.
effect.fr: Malédiction qui rend les jambes spongieuses, au point qu’il devient difficile de marcher ou même de tenir debout.

effect.en: Squiggle Quill was a transforming spell that transfigured writing quills into worms.
effect.fr: Métamorphose qui change les plumes à écrire en vers.

effect.en: The Stamina Charm was a charm that enhanced and restored an individual's stamina.
effect.fr: Charme qui avive et rétablit l’endurance.

effect.en: The Stealth Sensoring Spell was a charm that detected those trying to enter an area by stealth through magical means.
effect.fr: Charme qui détecte ceux qui tentent d’entrer quelque part en se dissimulant par magie.

effect.en: Sternius was the incantation of a dark charm that caused the victim to continually sneeze. This spell was used in duelling to distract and weaken the opponent.
effect.fr: Charme obscur qui fait éternuer la victime sans relâche. En duel, il distrait et affaiblit l’adversaire.

effect.en: The Stickfast Hex (Colloshoo) was a hex that stuck the target's shoes to the ground, causing them to trip if they attempted to move.
effect.fr: Maléfice (Colloshoo) qui colle les chaussures au sol : la cible trébuche dès qu’elle veut bouger.

effect.en: The Stinging Jinx , also known as the Stinging Hex, was a Dark charm that could be used to sting the victim's flesh, producing a red brand like a scorch mark and causing swelling. The Death Eater Antoine Grimalkin created a highly powerful variation of this jinx called the Frequensting, which he and his wife used to terrorise Great Britain during the First Wizarding War.
effect.fr: Charme obscur, aussi appelé maléfice de piqûre, qui pique la chair : une marque rouge comme une brûlure, et un gonflement. Le Mangemort Antoine Grimalkin en conçut une variante terrible, le Frequensting, dont il se servit avec sa femme pour terroriser la Grande-Bretagne pendant la première guerre des sorciers.

effect.en: The Stretching Jinx was a jinx which stretched the target.
effect.fr: Jinx qui étire la cible.

effect.en: The Stunning Spell (Stupefy), also known as the Stupefying Charm, or Stunner for short, was a charm that stunned the target, rendering them unconscious. This charm was exceptionally useful in duelling, as it can quickly end a duel without causing lasting damage. The spell also had the ability to halt moving objects. The counter-charm to the Stunning Spell was the Reviving Spell. It could also be defended against with the Shield Charm. Stupefy Duo was a more powerful variant of the spell.
effect.fr: Rend la cible inconsciente ; ce sort projette une boule de lumière rouge.

effect.en: The Summoning Charm (Accio) was a charm that summoned an object toward the caster. It was able to summon objects in direct line of sight of the caster, as well as things out of view, by calling the object aloud after the incantation (unless the spell was cast nonverbally). This spell needed thought behind it, and the caster had to clearly visualise the object in their mind before trying to summon it. Any distraction would make the spell ineffective. The opposite charm of the Summoning Charm was the Banishing Charm.
effect.fr: Fait voler vers soi un objet, même sur une bonne distance. Il semble que l'auteur du sort doive connaître au moins de façon approximative l'endroit où se trouve l'objet à attirer.

effect.en: The Sunlight Charm (Lumos Solem), also known as the Lumos Solem Spell, was a charm used to produce a blinding flash of sunlight. As Devil's Snare hated sunlight and heat, this particular light-creation spell was very effective towards subduing it. Wearing sunglasses was advised when practising this spell to protect one's eyes from the blinding light of the spell. Specific wrist motions could modulate the volume of light the spell produced.
effect.fr: Charme (Lumos Solem) qui produit un éclat de vrai soleil, aveuglant. Le Filet du Diable hait la lumière et la chaleur : ce sort l’affaiblit fort. On conseille des lunettes noires à l’entraînement. Un geste de poignet plus ou moins ample module l’intensité.

hand.fr: Pointer la baguette vers la cible

effect.en: The Supersensory Charm was a charm that gave the target enhanced senses, allowing them to more easily perceive their surroundings.
effect.fr: Charme qui avive les sens, afin de mieux percevoir ce qui entoure la cible.

effect.en: The Switching Spell was a transfiguration spell used to switch the positions of two objects. By definition, it was a simultaneous transfiguration of two objects to make them look like each other. The spell was studied in transfiguration class by fifth-years and fourth-years respectively during the 1988–1989 and 1994–1995 school years. Hermione Granger, however, gained points for knowing about Switching Spells in her first year.
effect.fr: Une partie des sorts de Métamorphose qui transforme une chose en une autre.

effect.en: When a word was spoken, the caster was alerted and protective enchantments around the speaker were weakened
effect.fr: Dès que le mot est prononcé, le lanceur en est alerté et les enchantements protecteurs autour de celui qui a parlé s’affaiblissent.

effect.en: This spell caused the victim to grow a tail.
effect.fr: Sort qui fait pousser une queue à la victime.

effect.en: This spell was a transforming spell used to turn a teacup into a tortoise.
effect.fr: Métamorphose qui change une tasse à thé en tortue.

hand.fr: Diagonale bas-droite, haut, puis diagonale bas-droite

effect.en: This was a transforming spell , that when cast correctly, transformed a teapot into a tortoise.
effect.fr: Métamorphose qui, bien jetée, change une théière en tortue.

effect.en: This spell was a charm used to straighten crooked teeth.
effect.fr: Charme qui redresse les dents croches.

effect.en: This was a spell that vanished objects which then appeared elsewhere.
effect.fr: Sort qui fait disparaître des objets pour les faire réapparaître ailleurs.

effect.en: Tentaclifors was the incantation of a Dark charm that transfigured the head of the targeted individual into a tentacle.
effect.fr: Charme obscur qui métamorphose la tête de la cible en tentacule.

effect.en: The Terrifying Charm was a charm. Its exact effect was unknown, but it was likely used to terrify the target.
effect.fr: Charme dont l’effet exact n’est pas connu ; il sert sans doute à terrifier la cible.

effect.en: The Tickling Charm, also known as the Tickle Charm, (Rictusempra) was a charm that caused the target to buckle with laughter, weakening them. It also had at least one other side effect.
effect.fr: Voir RICTUSEMPRA

effect.en: The Tickling Hex (Titillando), also known as the Tickling Spell, was a hex that tickled and subsequently weakened the target. The spell itself manifests in ghostly purple hands that attack and tickle the target.
effect.fr: Maléfice (Titillando), aussi appelé sortilège de chatouillis, qui chatouille la cible jusqu’à l’affaiblir. Il se manifeste par des mains violettes, spectrales, qui s’acharnent à la chatouiller.

name.fr: Maléfice de pousse des ongles de pied

effect.en: This hex was used to cause the victim's toenails to grow at an alarmingly fast rate.
effect.fr: Maléfice qui fait pousser les ongles de pied de la victime à une vitesse alarmante.

effect.en: The Tongue-Tying Curse (Mimblewimble), also known as the Tongue-Tying Spell, was a curse that tied the target's tongue in a knot, preventing them from making coherent speech. This feature also allowed one to prevent the victim from speaking the incantations of spells correctly, and hence like the Silencing Charm it was useful in duelling (though can be overcome with more advanced magic). It was covered in the book Curses and Counter-Curses, authored by Professor Vindictus Viridian.
effect.fr: Malédiction (Mimblewimble) qui noue la langue et empêche de parler clairement — donc de prononcer une incantation. Comme le charme du Silence, elle est précieuse en duel, encore que la magie plus avancée puisse la vaincre. On la trouve dans Maléfices et contre-maléfices, du professeur Vindictus Viridian.

effect.en: The tracking spell (Appare Vestigium) was a charm that revealed and illuminated traces of recent magical activity and showed magical footprints and track marks in an area.
effect.fr: Charme (Appare Vestigium) qui révèle et illumine les traces d’activité magique récente, ainsi que les empreintes et sillons magiques d’un lieu.

effect.en: The Transmogrifian Torture was a curse which presumably tortured its victims to death overtime.
effect.fr: Supplice supposé provoquer la mort.

effect.en: The Trip Jinx was a jinx used to make people trip and fall over.
effect.fr: Fait trébucher la victime.

effect.en: A hex that makes the victim’s ears twitch and jerk uncontrollably.
effect.fr: Maléfice qui force les oreilles de la victime à s’agiter et à remuer sans qu’elle puisse les maîtriser.

effect.en: The Unbreakable Charm was a charm that made an object unbreakable.
effect.fr: Rend un objet incassable.

effect.en: An Unbreakable Vow is a binding magical contract. A Bonder holds a wand to the joined hands of the two parties; if either later breaks the terms, they die.
effect.fr: Le Serment Inviolable lie deux personnes par un contrat magique. L’Enchaîneur touche de sa baguette leurs mains jointes ; à chaque clause acceptée, une langue de feu rougeâtre s’enroule autour des mains. Quiconque enfreint le serment en meurt.

hand.fr: Placer la baguette entre les mains

effect.en: The Uninviting Charm was a charm. Its exact effect was unknown.
effect.fr: Charme dont l’effet exact demeure inconnu.

effect.en: Unlocks doors and other locked objects.
effect.fr: Ouvre les portes et les objets verrouillés.

effect.en: This form of flight was a spell that allowed a witch or wizard to fly without the use of a broomstick or other form of support. The spell was notably demonstrated by Lord Voldemort.
effect.fr: Sort qui permet à un sorcier de voler sans balai ni autre appui. Lord Voldemort en donna une démonstration mémorable.

effect.en: This spell was a charm used to clean any object using the wand like a vacuum cleaner.
effect.fr: Charme qui nettoie un objet en se servant de la baguette comme d’un aspirateur.

hand.fr: Passer la baguette au-dessus de l’objet

name.fr: Sortilège de réparation de l’Armoire à disparaître

effect.en: The Vanishing Cabinet Repair Spell (Harmonia Nectere Passus) was a charm used to repair a broken Vanishing Cabinet and perfect its performance. It required more than simply speaking the incantation in front of the damaged device, proven by the fact that Draco Malfoy needed nearly a year to repair one.
effect.fr: Charme (Harmonia Nectere Passus) qui répare une Armoire à disparaître brisée et en rétablit le bon fonctionnement. Prononcer l’incantation ne suffit pas : Draco Malfoy mit près d’un an à en réparer une.

hand.fr: Pointer la baguette vers la cible

effect.en: The Vanishing Spell (Evanesco) was a Transfiguration spell used to vanish both animate and inanimate objects "into non-being, which is to say, everything".
effect.fr: Voir EVANESCO

effect.en: Ventus Duo was the incantation of a stronger variant of the the spell Ventus. The spell created a stronger jet of spiralling wind than the standard version, which could cause more damage to an opponent in a wizard's duel.
effect.fr: Variante renforcée de Ventus : un jet de vent en spirale, plus violent, qui blesse davantage en duel.

effect.en: Vera Verto was the incantation of a Transfiguration spell used to transform an animal into a water goblet. Animals susceptible to this spell were specifically aves, rats, and felines.
effect.fr: Métamorphose qui change un animal en gobelet. Elle agit surtout sur les oiseaux, les rats et les félins.

effect.en: Verdillious was the incantation of a charm that caused the wand tip to light up like a flare, exuding green light, sparks and smoke to damage an opponent.
effect.fr: Charme qui fait flamber la pointe de la baguette comme une fusée : lumière verte, étincelles et fumée, assez pour blesser un adversaire.

effect.en: The Verdimillious Charm (Verdimillious) was a charm that emitted green sparks from the wand. These sparks could be used to reveal objects hidden by Dark Arts and could be used offensively in a duel.
effect.fr: Charme (Verdimillious) qui fait jaillir des étincelles vertes. Elles peuvent révéler des objets cachés par les Arts sombres, et servir en duel.

effect.en: The Verdimillious Duo Spell (Verdimillious) was a charm that emitted green sparks from the tip of the wand. It was a more powerful version of the Verdimillious Charm. It held a number of useful purposes and was rather easy to cast.
effect.fr: Charme (Verdimillious) qui fait jaillir des étincelles vertes de la baguette. Version plus puissante du charme Verdimillious, assez facile à jeter, et utile à plus d’un titre.

effect.en: Vermiculus was the incantation of a transforming jinx used to transfigure things into worms.
effect.fr: Jinx de métamorphose qui change les choses en vers.

effect.en: A spell whose exact effect remains unknown.
effect.fr: Sort dont l’effet exact demeure inconnu.

effect.en: This curse caused the victim considerable pain, agony, and illness for years afterwards. It could not be cured by any ordinary means, as both healing magic and Shrivelfigs had no impact. It was suggested that it could be cured through a Dark relic, though this was never attempted in practice.
effect.fr: Malédiction qui inflige, des années durant, douleur, tourment et maladie. Ni la magie de guérison ni les figues à ratatinage n’y peuvent rien. On a suggéré qu’une relique obscure pourrait la lever ; cela n’a jamais été tenté.

effect.en: Vulnera Sanentur was the song-like incantation of a healing spell which healed deep wounds, and could also be used as the counter-curse for the curse Sectumsempra.
effect.fr: Incantation chantante d’un sort de guérison qui referme les plaies profondes. C’est aussi le contre-sort de Sectumsempra.

hand.fr: Passer la baguette sur les plaies

effect.en: The Wand-Extinguishing Charm (Nox) was a charm that caused the light at the end of the caster's wand to be extinguished, thus acting as the counter-charm to the Wand-Lighting Charm (Lumos).
effect.fr: Eteint la lumière de " Lumos ".

effect.en: The Wand-Lighting Charm (Lumos) was a charm that illuminated the tip of the caster's wand, allowing the caster to see in the dark. The counter-charm for the spell was the Wand-Extinguishing Charm (Nox), which was used to extinguish the light from the caster's wand. The charm could be used to reveal magically hidden things.
effect.fr: Fait jaillir un petit faisceau de lumière de l'extrémité de la baguette de l'auteur.

effect.en: This spell enchanted dirty dishes to wash themselves.
effect.fr: Sort qui ensorcelle la vaisselle sale pour qu’elle se lave toute seule.

effect.en: The Water-Making Spell, also known as the Aguamenti Charm or the Water-Conjuring Charm, (Aguamenti) was a charm that conjured a jet of clean, drinkable water from the tip of the caster's wand. This spell, in addition to being a charm, could also be classified as conjuration, an advanced form of Transfiguration.
effect.fr: Sortilège qui fait apparaître une fontaine ou un jet d'eau de la baguette.

effect.en: Weight-loss charms were charms that reduce the weight of a person. Some weight-loss charms appeared to be "more serious" than others, and allowed wizards to eat high-calorie food all the time.
effect.fr: Charmes qui allègent le poids d’une personne. Certains, plus « sérieux » que d’autres, permettent de manger sans cesse des plats très riches.

effect.en: White sparks was a charm that precipitated a jet of white sparks from the tip of the wand. It could also be used offensively as a minor duelling spell. When these sparks were produced in large quantities, it was difficult to see or breathe when in the vicinity.
effect.fr: Charme qui fait jaillir un jet d’étincelles blanches de la baguette. On peut s’en servir en duel, comme sort mineur. En grande quantité, ces étincelles gênent la vue et la respiration.

effect.en: The Windy Spell (Ventus) was a charm which shot a jet of strong, spiralling wind from the tip of the wand.
effect.fr: Charme (Ventus) qui fait jaillir de la baguette un jet de vent violent, en spirale.

effect.en: The Wiping Spell (Tergeo) was the incantation of a cleaning spell used to siphon liquids such as blood, dust or grease, and to clean objects.
effect.fr: Nettoye la cible ; objet ou individu.

hand.fr: Pointer la baguette vers la cible
